6.213 rsInvalidFixedTableColumnHeaderSpacing
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidFixedTableColumnHeaderSpacing is a critical error that will occur if, for a TableColumns
collection, the set of TableColumn elements with TableColumn.FixedHeader set to true are not
contiguous or if the TableColumns collection does not include the first or last TableColumn in the
collection.
